notes: Measured algorithm (pixel-exact vs AE): the tile image is built by exact area averaging (box of 100/tile% layer px per tile px, grid anchored at the tile corner = Tile Center - tile/2); tiles landing on fractional positions (Phase shifts) are placed with bilinear interpolation of that tile image; 8 bpc rounds x.5 up (shader adds +0.02/255). Horizontal Phase Shift: odd rows (row 0 holds Tile Center) move right by Phase/360 * tile width. Not measured / assumptions: vertical Phase (Horizontal Phase Shift off) mirrors the horizontal case (odd columns move down by Phase/360 * tile height); Mirror + Phase mirrors by the shifted tile index; Output Width/Height < 100 % crop symmetrically around the layer centre, > 100 % (layer expansion) is not reproduced because the shader assumes canvas = layer (the generated node's `pad` grows the canvas but Params carries no layer size, so pad must stay 0); non-integer tile sizes (e.g. 33 % of 640) use a continuous global tile-pixel grid, AE may round the tile size; tiles under ~6.7 % of the layer (footprint > 16 px) use an approximate box (8 evenly spaced bilinear taps per axis). AE 9 (Compositing Options, built-in effect opacity/masks) not reproduced.
